faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our cooperative model, pricing, and safety standards.

items.q: How does SahkarSathi verify workers and ensure home safety?
items.a: Every craftsperson completes 4-tier verification: Aadhaar-based eKYC, independent police background verification, practical skill trade certification evaluated by cooperative master craftspeople, and formal e-Shram government linkage.

items.q: How are prices calculated and why is there no surge pricing?
items.a: Rates are established democratically by the regional trade cooperative councils based on fair living wages and material standards. Because we are a cooperative rather than a venture-backed middleman, we don't hike prices during peak hours or rainy days.

items.q: How does bulk hiring and team formation work for construction or renovation?
items.a: When you choose 'Hire a team', our platform assembles the exact composition of verified masons, electricians, carpenters, plumbers, and painters required. A certified Chief Supervisor manages site coordination, timeline, and quality so you only interact with one leader.

items.q: How does escrow payment protection work?
items.a: For larger and milestone-based projects, your advance payment is held in a cooperative-governed escrow account. Funds are released to workers only after each agreed project milestone is completed and certified by both the supervisor and the customer.

items.q: What happens if I have a complaint or the work needs correction?
items.a: All cooperative services carry a 14-day SahkarSathi Cooperative Service Guarantee. If any repair does not meet standard trade quality, the cooperative dispatches a senior master inspector to resolve it at zero additional cost.

items.q: How is customer and worker personal data kept private?
items.a: We strictly respect data privacy. Contact numbers and addresses are shared through masked tokens until a booking is accepted. Aadhaar details are processed via UIDAI-compliant OTP tokens and are never sold or used for advertising.
